figure.title: Overgo — Recursive self-improvement
figure.purpose: Show the RSI implementation intent: durable observations trigger the next experiment, improving task capability, robustness and efficiency through derived methods and resource-aware execution.

visual_language.typography: modern sans-serif; one main title, functional stage labels, regular-weight supporting text; no subheaders
visual_language.effects: Uniform solid SVG fills and strokes; no textures, gradients, filters, shadows or image layers

operator_direction.text: Operators set goals, budgets, constraints and stop conditions.

connections.label: Use outcomes to identify improvements in capability, robustness and efficiency, then generate the next proposal.

recursive_step.text: Outcomes improve models, methods and the improvement process itself.

lines: OvergoDB records evidence and state across every stage:
identities and lineage · runs and decisions · checkpoints and active versions
Derive values; eliminate unnecessary literals and magic numbers.
Justify assumptions about shape, distribution and geometry.
Scale Go and CUDA execution to available RAM, VRAM,
Adapt placement, batching and concurrency; preserve correctness.

semantic_constraints: Present implementation and RSI intent without promotional or maturity framing.
Proposals do not themselves authorize execution or activation; executable policy owns admission and decisions.
Observe-to-propose is intended to become durable automatic feedback through the existing driver.
Rejection, waiting, resumption and rollback remain part of the process.
Derive values and justify assumptions rather than prohibiting mathematically or contractually required operations.
Use available RAM, VRAM, CPU and GPU capacity within operator limits.
OvergoDB retains pending work and consumed budgets as well as results.
Capability, robustness and total resource cost are joint evaluation dimensions.
rendering_constraints: One main title and no subtitle or section subheaders.
Retain the functional stage labels and numbers; all supporting statements use regular-weight text.
Preserve one clockwise six-stage loop with a clearly labelled Observe-to-Propose return.
Keep connectors outside labels with visible arrowheads and no crossings.
Show OvergoDB as a foundation shared across every stage.
Keep the two supporting columns unheaded and readable at 1200px display width.
Use native SVG geometry and text for uniform fills and crisp lettering; export PNG at twice the SVG viewBox resolution.
Keep the JSON semantic definition, SVG source, and PNG export synchronized.
